Polisa — contract, storage & Android surface

Static reconstruction of the Polisa policy object and its Android companion (voice chat, memory sync, visualizers). No backend required — this build renders fully offline for preview & capture validation.

✅ Static build: /dist ✅ Offline capable ✅ Desktop + mobile ready

Voice chat

Mic → WebSpeech / native STT → agent turn → TTS. Reverse-engineered intents: polisa.read, polisa.explain, memory.sync.

Memory sync

Local-first store with vector notes. Sync payload: { policyId, clauses, embeddings } over HTTPS + retry queue.

Polisa object — reverse-engineered schema

policyId
POL-XXXXXX — stable key, QR + NFC tag on Android
holder / insured
name, PESEL hash, address — PII stored encrypted (AES-GCM, Android Keystore)
clauses[]
id, title, body, exclusions, embeddings[384] for semantic search
premium
amount, currency (PLN), schedule monthly/quarterly, nextDue ISO date
attachments
PDF hash (SHA-256), pages, OCR text
